LESSON: DUA BEFORE AND AFTER WAKING UP.

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: MORAL 6.1 Islamic etiquettes: By the end of the sub-strand the  Learners are gu
Topic 6.1.3: Dua before and after waking up.

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Dua before and after waking up.. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Dua before and after waking up.
2. Practise Dua before and after waking up. at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Dua before and after waking up.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Dua before and after waking up.
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Dua before and after waking up. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Dua before and after waking up. at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Dua before and after waking up. at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Dua before and after waking up.
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Dua before and after waking up. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Dua before and after waking up. using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Dua before and after waking up. in the examples.
2. Explain Dua before and after waking up. to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Dua before and after waking up..
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Dua before and after waking up. using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Dua before and after waking up. important for a Grade 2 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Learners repeatedly recite the Duas to dua before sleeping for Allah’s help in memorization. protection and dua after waking

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Dua before and after waking up.
2. Practise Dua before and after waking up. at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Dua before and after waking up.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
